text1: A bombarded barren world locked in a decaying orbit around Avici. Tidal fractures cross its cooling crust, and every projection of its path ends inside the black hole.
An old, self-contained orbital habitat built for over ten thousand people. Eighty-seven human life-signs remain aboard, crowded around the last functioning life-support loop.
The orbital habitat is completely empty. Nothing remains inside its pressurized compartments except the faintest wisps of red-tinged smoke.
A ruptured habitat destroyed by antimatter fuel canisters. Its remaining compartments are open to vacuum and no life-signs remain.

A Domain gateway reduced to a broken skeleton beneath centuries of Starving Threat accretion. The organisms have consumed its structure layer by layer and arranged the remains into repeating topological patterns. Their reconstruction is vast, deliberate, and still incomplete.
The ruined Ring cannot accept a Janus handshake. Its surviving alignments preserve only fragmentary navigation information: evidence of a path from the Orion Knot to the Domain Heartland.
A barren planet eaten through on a continental scale. Its mantle has cooled inside exposed tunnels, its crust has been stripped of every useful deposit, and nothing living or artificial remains.

A specialized combat core reconstructed from sealed Odyssean research archives. Its narrow heuristics map the improvised architecture and recurring material faults of Starving Threat organisms. Assigned to a recovered Domain Derelict, it substantially improves damage against those targets while providing the combat judgment of an experienced automated officer.
A fortress-scale descendant of the Mark IX autocannon. Its twin loaders feed kinetic projectiles comparable in size to frigates into barrels integrated directly with FOB Ithaca's structure.
A destroyable armored station module carrying one FOB Ithaca naval gun. It forms part of the fortress wall's forward face.
A non-colliding encounter-only background structure beneath FOB Ithaca's turret line.
A fortress bombardment emplacement that saturates approach lanes with oversized gravity bombs. Every fourth round carries a blinking red danger beacon and a Reaper-class warhead.
A destroyable armored station module carrying one Damocles bombardment gun in FOB Ithaca's forward face.

A fortress-scale vertical-launch battery carrying twenty exposed missile caps. Its fixed one-degree hardpoint fires fifteen missiles in a newly shuffled tube order for each volley; each missile follows a slightly different weaving path after clearing the rack.
A destroyable armored station module carrying one Metal Storm VLS battery in FOB Ithaca's forward face.
The continuous load-bearing frame of an isolated fragment of Ithaca's wall. Seven armored station sections are seated in its open berth sockets; the frame fails when all seven have been destroyed.
One independently destroyable armored section seated inside the drifting wall's central frame. Most are silent; a single section still carries an operational mega-turret.
An exposed self-repairing reactor mounted behind the Drifting Wall's surviving foundation. Disabling it shuts down the Wall without destroying the ancient structure.

A material-starved THREAT skirmisher. Reduced hull mass and reinforced armor accompany extreme maneuverability; when destroyed, its surviving fragments become attack swarms rather than reclamation swarms.

A material-starved THREAT overseer. Reduced hull mass and reinforced armor accompany extreme maneuverability; when destroyed, its surviving fragments become attack swarms rather than reclamation swarms.

A material-starved THREAT assault unit. Reduced hull mass and reinforced armor accompany extreme maneuverability; when destroyed, its surviving fragments become attack swarms rather than reclamation swarms.
A material-starved THREAT hive. Reduced hull mass and reinforced armor accompany extreme maneuverability; when destroyed, its surviving fragments become attack swarms rather than reclamation swarms.

A material-starved THREAT line unit. Reduced hull mass and reinforced armor accompany extreme maneuverability; when destroyed, its surviving fragments become attack swarms rather than reclamation swarms.
A material-starved THREAT fabricator. It constructs only Starving Threat units, consuming half the normal amount of its own combat readiness for each unit built.
Constructs only Starving Threat units while consuming half the normal amount of the Fabricator's combat readiness.

A dark Fabricator knot through which the light-year-spanning filament web called Ungaikyo acts locally. It retains a stock THREAT Fabricator's armament while summoning and resurrecting hostile reflections of the opposing fleet. Its Reflection Swarm system combines continuous construction with an autonomous backward Extraction Protocol maneuver.

Summons up to 240 deployment points of hostile fleet reflections without consuming Ungaikyo's own deployment allowance, then reconstructs destroyed reflections. Civilian hulls are replaced by stock THREAT combat units of equivalent size. When pressured, Ungaikyo uses Extraction Protocol to accelerate backward, then vents flux and replenishes weapon ammunition. Construction continues during the maneuver. The extraction lasts five seconds with a twelve-second cooldown and requires no Overseer activation.
Gautama is an immense, asymmetrical THREAT command organism equipped with Energy Lash. It cannot fabricate ships, but continuously replaces a screen of up to twenty fragile Attack Swarms.
A legacy zero-bay configuration of the immense THREAT command organism once designated Gautama.
An extremely fragile Attack Swarm in Gautama's endlessly replenished screen. Its underlying fighter produces no death explosion or hulk.

Budai is an enlarged Shrouded Maw held inside a maintained distortion. Fire entering from outside the field is attenuated, while ships that cross its boundary are slowed and repeatedly struck by Shrouded Lens discharges. When wounded, it convulses through space before the field expands and turns red.

A phase-capable Domain assault transport carrying five autonomous boarding craft. Its pods defend the transport until exposed hostile hull is detected, then break formation and attach for a ten-second combat-readiness drain.
An armored Spartan boarding craft. It remains close to its Phantom carrier until it detects exposed hull, then commits to boarding.
An otherwise standard Omega Facet used to isolate and test a local time-arrest system.

Arrests local combat time for thirty seconds while leaving the activating ship synchronized and multiplying its maneuverability fivefold. A flagship with an active Temporal Shell also remains free to move.
text3: Stops ships, fighters, weapons, systems, and projectiles; active Temporal Shell counters it.

text1: A fortress-scale Locust derivative fixed into six armored sockets in FOB Ithaca's intact foundation. Each Cloudswarm fires a replenishing 41-missile intercept burst; the Fortress Autoloader Core expands that burst and magazine to 81. Its guidance gives absolute priority to hostile missiles, then fighters and combat drones, and refuses targeting solutions against ordinary ships. The launchers remain dormant until the Interception Command Matrix is recovered.

A fortress-scale battery firing eight Hammer-class unguided torpedoes in a broad sixty-degree fan. Recovered Ithaca guidance specifications can refit every round into an Atropos-class guided torpedo without sacrificing salvo size or strategic engagement range.
The Siege Munitions Compiler's live refit of an Ithaca Hammer battery. Each of its eight fortress-launched torpedoes carries Atropos guidance and maneuvering systems.
